items.title: Marilyn Crispell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 21, 2022
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you happen to know a fellow named A.B. Spellman? [INTERVIEWEE] Sure.

ctx.x: Sure, lot of people. I think everybody does that, you know, you imitate the people you are attracted to musically and then your own voice kind of comes out of that. But it’s almost like being a child and having to start somewhere and listening to your parents talk and imitating them before you can actually say anything. So Cecil Taylor was a huge, huge influence. And McCoy Tyner, who is actually probably the first one because of listening to “A Love Supreme.” So he was a huge influence and for a long time I think…
Do you happen to know a fellow named A.B. Spellman?
